title: Quick Roasted Russian Potato Bake
description: A hearty one-pot Russian dish featuring roasted potatoes and starch, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this jain-friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced potatoes with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika until they are evenly coated.
In a large one-pot dish, create a layer of potatoes, followed by a layer of chopped onion, then a layer of sliced mushrooms, and finally a layer of grated carrots.
Repeat the layering process until all the ingredients have been used, ending with a layer of potatoes on top.
Drizzle the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil over the top layer of potatoes.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown and the vegetables are tender.
Remove the dish from the oven and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
